verdict.rationale: Databricks documents versioned REST APIs side by side (e.g., Jobs v2.0 alongside the latest, with a recommendation to use the latest). It also publishes per-API deprecation and migration guides, such as the legacy SQL API (/api/2.0/preview/sql/queries → /api/2.0/sql/queries), noting the legacy API is 'deprecated and support will end soon', plus a CLI 0.18→0.205 migration path. However, there is no evidence of a formal, platform-wide deprecation policy with defined timelines or support windows. Missing for 10: a documented general deprecation policy with notice periods or sunset timelines, concrete end-of-support dates (the SQL API notice only says 'soon'), and independent corroboration of versioning stability.
